subject: Request: Evidence & runbook for territory scope (SOC 2 / SIG / CAIQ) and VPC/keystore details
messages:
From: Anna Li <anna.li@healco.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@healco.com
Date: 2027-05-02T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Evidence request — SOC2/SIG/CAIQ + region hosting confirmation

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the demo last week. As part of our security review we need a compact evidence packet that covers Redwood's current SOC 2 Type II report, a SIG/CAIQ mapping, and clear statements about where customer data may be hosted for HealCo (we need explicit confirmation for EU and APAC nodes). In particular we need:

- The latest SOC 2 Type II report (redacted if needed) and a point-of-contact for an attestation call.
- A SIG or CAIQ mapping that marks which questions are applicable for private deployments (VPC / on-prem) vs hosted.
- Diagram and brief notes describing VPC/private peering options, expected IP ranges, and whether a private peering option supports cross-border failover to other regions.
- Clarify keystore/KMS locations and the operator separation model (e.g., are operator keys in a separate account/zone?).

We're trying to complete HealCo's supplier review by May 12. Is a 7–10 business day turnaround feasible? If you need an NDA or different channel for attachments, let me know.

Thanks,
Anna
Anna Li
Head of InfoSec — HealCo
anna.li@healco.com

[Attachment: supplier-questionnaire-healco.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Anna Li <anna.li@healco.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-05-02T12:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence request — SOC2/SIG/CAIQ + region hosting confirmation

Anna — thanks for the clear note and timeline. We can meet your May 12 target. Plan below:

1) Deliver a compact evidence packet within 5 business days (SOC2, CAIQ export, SIG mapping) and a VPC/peering diagram.
2) Provide a short ops runbook that describes how we handle keystore separation, KMS regioning, and peering fallback policies for EU/APAC.
3) If HealCo requires a call with our compliance lead, we can schedule a 30-min Q&A the week after packet delivery.

Action items for us (assignments):
- Irene: pull SOC 2 Type II report (redacted) and CAIQ export, produce SIG mapping for private vs hosted controls.
- Grace: produce VPC peering diagram + short runbook section on KB (keystore) operator model and traffic egress controls.
- I'll compile and deliver the packet and open a HubSpot attachment for you.

We will include: SOC2-TypeII-Report-2026.pdf, SIG-Mapping-Runbook.xlsx, CAIQ-Export-2026.json, vpc-peering-diagram.svg, keystore-operator-manifest.csv. Please confirm whether HealCo needs signed NDA before we deliver the SOC 2 doc.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Sales Engineer — Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
Phone: +1 415-555-0198

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-05-03T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence request — SOC2/SIG/CAIQ + region hosting confirmation

Marissa / Grace — taking ownership of evidence pulls. Quick notes for the packet and ops runbook: 

- SOC 2: We have the Type II report running through 2026 Q4 (redacted copy ok). POC: me (irene_choi@).
- CAIQ: I will export the 2026 CAIQ JSON and attach a short mapping that calls out private-deploy controls.
- SIG mapping: I'll produce the XLSX with a column that flags controls 'applies_to: hosted|private|both'.
- Keystore/KMS: ops confirms that customer keys for private deployments can be placed in customer-managed KMS in the EU or APAC region; operator access is separated by account IDs listed in keystore-operator-manifest.csv (redacted manifest attached).
- VPC peering: Grace, can you ensure the diagram includes IP CIDR ranges (placeholder ranges OK) and notes on cross-region failover behavior (we allow controlled failover to a fallback region but only with contractual acceptance).

I'll attach interim artifacts to the compliance folder and link the JIRA for audit trace: JIRA-REQ-9124.

Irene Choi
Compliance Manager — Redwood Inference
irene_choi@redwoodinference.com

[Attachment stubs referenced: SOC2-TypeII-Report-2026.pdf (pdf), CAIQ-Export-2026.json (json), SIG-Mapping-Runbook.xlsx (xlsx), keystore-operator-manifest.csv (csv)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Anna Li <anna.li@healco.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com>, procurement@healco.com
Date: 2027-05-04T15:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence request — SOC2/SIG/CAIQ + region hosting confirmation

Anna — attached is the initial evidence packet we discussed. Files included below and a short summary of the residency/peering controls for HealCo.

Attachments (attached to this email):
- SOC2-TypeII-Report-2026.pdf (redacted)
- CAIQ-Export-2026.json (raw export)
- SIG-Mapping-Runbook.xlsx (mapping with applicability flags)
- vpc-peering-diagram.svg (diagram + notes)
- keystore-operator-manifest.csv (redacted operator IDs)

Summary (short):
- Region hosting: For customer data in Hosted mode, primary nodes for EU are in eu-central-1 and for APAC in ap-northeast-1. For Private/VPC deployments, you may pin to a customer-only zone in EU or APAC; keystore (customer-managed KMS) can be provisioned in the chosen region.
- VPC peering: We support private peering and transit via our Private Gateway. Peering supports scheduled cross-region failover, but cross-border automatic failover requires explicit contractual acceptance (we've noted this in the runbook).
- Keystore/operator separation: Operator access is limited to a separate operator account; key usage logs are forwarded to a customer-designated log sink on request.

Next steps:
1) Please confirm whether HealCo needs an NDA signed before we provide any additional unredacted artifacts.
2) If you'd like a 30-min Q&A, propose 2–3 times and we'll book.
3) We can produce a one-page residency attestation letter if that helps procurement.

Thanks — happy to walk through anything live.

Best regards,
Marissa Cole
Senior Sales Engineer — Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
+1 415-555-0198
